sourceBindings.text: There is a clean plastic sampling bucket and a galvanized bucket with a worn inner surface. Both can hold all the subsamples.
Choose the verified clean plastic bucket for this nutrient-sampling task.
Explain that the galvanized coating can introduce zinc, and rust or metal flakes may also distort relevant measurements.
Check the plastic bucket for old soil, fertilizer or chemical residue too. Plastic material alone does not prove cleanliness.
Container choice and cleanliness are two checks, not alternatives.
